name: watchlist_check
description: Run one or all watchlists against live data from the sidecar. For each watchlist item, queries the appropriate endpoint and returns only items with new activity since the last check. Updates the last-checked timestamp on completion. Use this for periodic monitoring of tracked entities.

parameters.name: string (optional) — Specific watchlist name to check. Omit to check all watchlists.

examples.description: Check all watchlists for new activity
